_README: The same captured ZTPF device surface as `ztpf_device_surface`, presented
the way an 8.0 box presents it: personas come from the `assistant_personas`
MODULE (not the legacy Key Store), and the `assistant_skills` module carries
WHY A VARIANT AND NOT A FLAG ON THE BASE BUNDLE: the legacy Key Store path
is still shipped and still resolves personas on pre-8.0 boxes, so the
existing rows must keep exercising it. Two substrates, two bundles, one
capture -- `extends` means the records cannot drift apart.
The house rules below are deliberately CHECKABLE against this capture: the
playbook named in the first rule is a real active record-action playbook in
the bundle. A seeded skill that names a playbook the box does not have
teaches the assistant a name that fails, and is worse than no skill at all.

skills.trigger: when asked to run pending automation steps
skills.instruction: To execute pending automation steps on a device, run the playbook 'Create Run Group and Execute Steps' -- it groups the pending steps and executes them. Never invent a playbook name; list the module's playbooks if unsure.

skills.trigger: when summarizing what was done to a device
skills.instruction: Always state how many automation steps you looked at, and say so explicitly when the result set was truncated rather than summarizing only the first page.
This rule is scoped to another module and must NOT reach a ztpf_devices turn.
This rule is disabled and must NOT reach any turn.
